description: This file defines several interface declarations related to streaming grains in an Orleans-based project, including producer, consumer, inline consumer, and a grain with generic methods.

methods.name: BecomeProducer
methods.description: Sets up the grain as a producer with specified stream ID, namespace, and provider.

methods.name: StartPeriodicProducing
methods.description: Starts periodic production of items in the stream.

methods.name: GetNumberProduced
methods.description: Retrieves the number of items produced.

methods.name: ClearNumberProduced
methods.description: Resets the count of items produced.

methods.name: Produce
methods.description: Produces a single item into the stream.

methods.name: BecomeConsumer
methods.description: Sets up the grain as a consumer for a specific stream.

methods.name: GetNumberConsumed
methods.description: Retrieves the number of items consumed.

methods.name: ValueTaskMethod
methods.description: A generic method returning a ValueTask<int>, possibly with cache usage.
